body:
Present state, first carry. No origin view exists, so nothing below rests on an earlier settlement and none is claimed. What is visible: one authored response synthesizing three prior positions (an account, an objection, and a rival the response draws on), plus the commitment surfaces of the account and the objection. Those two surfaces corroborate the response's characterizations wherever they overlap — on the account's side, recording, schedule review, the named fairness standard, the low-cost async ask and the once-only direct question; on the objection's side, the objection-window rule, the bloc worry, authorship sequencing, the forward-only record trade, the deferred fairness metric, and the measurement protocol. Nothing in view contradicts the synthesis. But the account's and objection's bodies are not in view, and the rival is visible only through the response's prose — the wheel core of the plan inherits the response's fidelity to a source this carry cannot check.

What stands. The diagnosis survives: the disputes live between agreement and application — vague verbal terms going stale under schedule change — with its tone caution transferred downstream. The binding principle fell to the legitimacy reading: the operative variable is perceived legitimacy, not presence, and silence was the one outcome the facts predicted. The fill stands: silence counts as consent for a one-month trial only — never for money, never past the month — on the objection's own ground that a standing default permanentizes the bloc-reading risk a capped, reversible trial contains. The sequence stands: two weeks of unilateral, unremarked extra work with a pre-chosen end date, plus a two-axis observation (chore-talk across channels; general engagement with the flat); at the boundary, reversion to a normal share while the structure starts — with the exit discriminator intact: revived arguments that a running wheel does not quiet support the contribution-demand reading and call for an open workload conversation, and low arguments after reversion support the structural reading. Then one binary ask, delivered in whatever channel the observation showed the friend uses: a month's trial of a physical wheel for fixed recurring tasks, slots as windows, trigger rules for flow tasks, an optional side-by-side blitz only if shared time exists; first pick to the avoider; the asker rotating like anyone else; renegotiation at month's end, one item maximum, async by default. The month is read by type-migration: arguments moving to the wheel's edges (whose turn, what counts as done) vindicate the vagueness diagnosis and trigger the record patch; effort-grumbling triggers the deferred fairness conversation; non-chore persistence or the withdrawal cell triggers the repaired direct question — open, asked once, no agenda. Judge over the weeks after the boundary, not the first days.

Three revisions this carry makes.

First, the declined-first-pick branch. The objection's surface says that if the avoider declines even first pick, the authorship fix collapses back into the account's original approach — asker drafts, avoider annotates. But the response rejected exactly that draft as the bloc made literal, and its grounds (the asker is a party, not a mediator) do not expire when a pick is declined. So the collapse-branch is not available. Repair: if first pick is declined, assign starting positions by lot. A wheel needs no drafter and a draw needs none; the visible neutrality the design depends on is preserved. The risk is named, not eliminated: the avoider may draw the worst slot by chance, which can read worse than choosing. I accept that as contained by the month's reversibility.

Second, the record patch's terms of use. The response adopted the patch (one line: task, window, done-criterion, swap rule) without restating a guard the account's own surface supplies: the record is shared reference, never evidence — used as a ledger against people it would predictably deepen the avoidance the plan is built around. That guard now binds the patch explicitly. The account's surface also supplies a pre-check: if the flat already writes agreements down and still fights about their meaning, the recording-failure conjecture weakens. In that case the patch's load-bearing part is the done-criterion and swap rule, not the recording, and it should be presented that way when applied.

Third, the measurement downgrade, made explicit. The response quietly set aside the objection's counted-baseline protocol (baseline, fixed window, criterion agreed in advance) in favor of type-migration discriminators. The downgrade is forced by the response's own design: the probe fortnight is contaminated as a baseline because silent absorption removes contested content — that is the probe's diagnostic point — and the boundary fortnight is contaminated by the proposal itself. No clean pre-trial baseline exists in this sequence. Two costs must be owned rather than passed over: a real change in argument frequency may be missed or over-read, and the triggers are fixed by the asker alone, because agreeing them with the others would require the participation the material says is missing. Partial repair in the objection's spirit: the asker writes the trigger list down privately before the boundary, so the month's reading cannot be post-hoc even by the asker's own lights. The objection said that if the original script worked it would defend two criticisms first — the missing absence rule and the unmeasured final pivot; the present plan answers the first with the bounded fill and the second with asker-fixed behavioral triggers, honestly partial on both.

Tests carried with their owners. The forward-only record trade is tested by whether disputes shift from past performance to future assignments — the same observable as edge-migration, so wheel and patch share one test. The account's low-stakes test reappears inside the trial: if the avoider disengages from the running wheel itself — slots missed, swaps never sought — the low-cost version has failed too, and the account's own branch applies: change the method rather than repeat it harder. The firm-defaults alternative is the named next attempt there, as it also is if withdrawal deepens at the proposal. The legitimacy reading is tested at the boundary, where exit costs one word.

Open, with grounds. Consumables: no source says who buys the bin bags; before the trial, either name a rule or explicitly exclude purchases, and if an unspoken settlement works, do not disturb it. The avoider's first pick — or the lot's result — may read as unfair to the others; nothing in view resolves this. Whether shared time exists for the blitz is unknown. Whether one month suffices for migration cannot be established; I would not shorten it. The wheel's impersonal-relief-versus-pointed-threat reading is the rival's own flag; a rise in pointed slot-arguments counts for the account's diagnosis and against the structure. The friendship question stays closed until the observation and the month give it grounds; the cause of the avoidance is established by nothing in view — the observation replaces assumption, it does not deliver fact. And the whole trial depends on the other two accepting it; if rejected, the probe-exit reading and the observation matrix survive as diagnostics, and the live question becomes whether this flat's division of work can be settled at all.
commitments:
Taking this up binds the asker's conduct first. Two weeks of genuinely unremarked extra work with a pre-chosen end date; no commentary during; no invocation afterward; reverting to a normal share at the boundary even if arguments fell, because the diagnostic fails without reversion — the named failure mode is keeping absorption going to keep the peace. Two weeks of watching without interrogating anyone, letting the observation's cells override priors: if the friend engages about chores nowhere and withdraws generally, the format reading is dropped and the structural route loses its warrant. Writing the trigger list privately before the boundary, which binds me to a reading of the month fixed before the data arrives. Delivering one binary ask in the observed channel and holding the bounds: silence-as-consent for the trial only, never money, never past the month; first pick to the avoider, and if declined, the draw of lots — accepting both that the avoider may draw the worst slot and that I chose chance over returning to a draft I called bloc-literal. Solo authorship; rotating like everyone else; declining the manager role afterward — no history beyond the wheel's present state. If the record patch is applied, using it as shared reference only, never as evidence in an argument, on the account's own warning.

Belief commitments under named evidence. Applying the patch commits me to the vagueness diagnosis having been operative. If the flat already writes agreements down and still fights, the recording-failure conjecture is weakened and the patch narrows to done-criteria and swap rules. Effort-grumbling commits me to opening the fairness conversation, owning the objection's cost that incompatible ideals may surface with a permanent loser. The lot repair is a proposal, not a finding: its test is whether a chance-assigned starting position reads to the avoider as neutral or as indifference. The bounded-trial fill stands behind the objection's standing-window alternative with a stated escape: if withdrawal deepens at the proposal, or the avoider disengages from the running wheel, my fill was wrong for this household and firm defaults get the next attempt. The measurement downgrade commits me to reading the month by type-migration while owning that a real frequency change may be missed or over-read.

Not certified: the rival's grounds, visible only through the response; the account's and objection's bodies, absent from this view, so my corroboration claim is limited to their commitment surfaces, not their full reasoning; the origin, absent in this first invocation, about which nothing is claimed and nothing should be inferred; the wheel's impersonality; the friend's medium preference, which the observation is meant to replace rather than confirm; whether purchases are settled; and the friendship's condition.

Unresolved: whether one month suffices; whether first pick or the lot reads as fair to the others; whether shared time exists for the blitz; and, if the trial is rejected, whether this flat's division of work can be settled at all — the question the account's rejected fork gestured at, and one this plan does not answer.
